title: From emails to WMS orders
narration: Meet the Email-to-Order Agent. It turns shipping instructions from emails into warehouse orders, reducing repetitive data entry for your operations team.

title: One agent. Multiple email sources.
narration: The agent reads emails from customers, freight forwarders, and factory sites, including purchase orders, shipping instructions, and inbound delivery advice.

title: Understand the request
narration: It identifies inbound and outbound shipping intent, then extracts key order details, such as purchase order number, part number, quantity, and destination.

title: Check details. Flag exceptions.
narration: The agent validates order information and requests missing details. If order creation fails, a notification helps the team identify what needs attention.

title: Create the WMS order
narration: With the required information available, the agent creates the warehouse order in WMS and sends confirmation, helping the team prepare for warehouse operations.

title: Less manual work. More connected operations.
narration: Support covers Crane customers and warehouse transfers in Mexico, including a second warehouse. The benefits: faster order creation, fewer manual input errors, and cross-warehouse automation.
